$comment: The source of sf-reference-link's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/reference-link (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

appearance.summary: card is the reference as its own box: frame, fill and padding, the name on up to two lines, underlined under the pointer and on focus. inline is a link in running text (C147): it flows and wraps with the sentence, takes the size of the text around it and is always underlined; the type icon (icon, none by default) and the record's number (text) in a quiet ink go with the name. plain is the link alone on a line, taking the width of its text, for a reference inside something that is already a box -- a record’s field, a table cell -- underlined under the pointer; with line or size it keeps one line and ends in an ellipsis.

copy.summary: A card only: a «Копировать ссылку» / Copy link icon button at its end copies the full address (the clipboard component's data-sf-copy route, decision C48). Off by default.

disabled.summary: Render an unavailable, non-focusable reference without navigation.

href.summary: Real navigation destination. Required for an enabled reference.

icon.summary: The type icon before the name. Absent: the arrow in a card, a size or on a line, none in text (inline); empty: no icon at all

line.summary: Takes the text line of this form size as a link without the card, for a table cell, so the row keeps its control height.

size.summary: Form size: the reference becomes a control of that size, for a row of fields or a table cell. Empty keeps the card spacing.

state.summary: The target is gone: missing (deleted) or forbidden (no access). No link then: the words dimmed, the broken-link icon, the reason in words after the name («удалена», «нет доступа», in the page's language); href is not followed. Empty: a live reference.

target.summary: Native browsing-context target. _blank adds the open_in_new sign after the words and «(откроется в новой вкладке)» / "(opens in a new tab)" to the accessible name, in the page's language.

text.summary: Compact route, source or number shown beside the label: at the far end of a card or a line, after the name in a quiet ink in text (a record's number).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: The link is a native <a> inside the reference while href is set, the reference is not disabled and its target is not gone (state); a new tab (target _blank) adds its words to the name. Without href the label is plain text; when disabled the label is a link that is unavailable (role link, aria-disabled, no href, no focus); a gone target is plain text with its reason in words.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-reference-link for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim

x-summary: Navigation surface that pairs a real destination with a compact reference.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: a11y-role: link, the native <a> the template draws while href is set and the reference is not disabled (Enter follows it, Tab reaches it); without href, or disabled, the label is plain text and nothing takes focus. The name is the host's aria-label, else the label or its slot (§4.8).
icon is optional (§4.2) and keeps its getter: absent is the arrow, an empty attribute is no icon at all, which a string default cannot say.
size and line keep their getters: they map a form size onto the field-size ladder (fieldSize) before the class list reads it.
aria-label is a host attribute, never a setting (§3.1); the template reads it from the host.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (Документация, #) plus a label and text, plain, no icon, a size, a line and disabled.

css-variables: seven public variables (fill and border at rest, radius, link colour, padding inline and block, gap), read by the class sheet with the internal token as fallback (§6) and listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json.
version 1.0.0: the interface is unchanged; nothing is renamed, so aliases.json holds only the host attribute aria-label.

version 1.0.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.0.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.0.4: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.0.6 (2026-11-13, docs precheck smart content SC-S02, RL-01): a patch. aria-label has its summary. The card draws through component.reference-link 1.0.4: one line is the size 3 control height, 56 on a desktop (it was 58).

version 1.1.0 (2026-11-14, reference link study RL-8..RL-11, RL-16..RL-19; owner C105, C01, C18): a minor, settings unchanged. Through component.reference-link 1.1.0: icon to label is H2 of C105 in a card and a sized reference (--sf-space-1/2: 12, compact and phone 8), H3 on a line or plain (--sf-space-1/4: 4); a sized reference keeps one line with the line form's ellipsis; a line reference takes no card fill on hover; the icon is not selected or copied; inside the element the route stands above the link's overlay and can be selected, and a press on it follows the link unless text is selected (the element forwards the click, one click reaches the page); markup written with the classes alone keeps the overlay over the route, so every press on the card navigates there; the default arrow turns in a right-to-left page. A disabled reference's label is a link that is unavailable (role link, aria-disabled) instead of plain text, and the root no longer carries aria-disabled (the class disabled stays). Before its code the bare tag holds its box from its attributes (core rule, RL-18).

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C147, reference link study control/research/2026-11-14-reference-link.md): a minor, three settings added, nothing renamed. (1) appearance inline: a reference in running text -- one inline run that flows and wraps with the sentence and takes the text's size; card stays the box. plain and line keep working as the one-line form for a field or a table cell. (2) A record reference: the type icon (icon; none by default in text), the name and the number (text) in a quiet ink. (3) Underline: always in text (inline); in a card, a size, on a line and plain only under the pointer and on keyboard focus. (4) target _blank: the open_in_new sign after the words (H3, 4) and «(откроется в новой вкладке)» in the name, as sf-file-download says it (C25), words in the page's language (lang runtime new-tab-text). (5) A visited colour only where a page opts in -- data-sf-visited="on" on any ancestor (sites, documentation) -- and only for a reference in text; apps and tables never show it. (6) state missing | forbidden: no link, dimmed words, link_off, the reason in words (missing-text, forbidden-text). (7) The C59 hover card is not in the Framework yet (float-anchor carries it in stage S4): nothing is drawn; the card will anchor on .sf-reference-link__link, the canonical element, with its 0.5 s delay. (8) copy: a card's «Копировать ссылку» icon button, the clipboard component's data-sf-copy route (C48 feedback and name tooltip), the address resolved in full. (9) A long name: a card shows two lines, a sized reference, a line or plain one; a cut name has its whole text in the Framework tooltip (data-tooltip, the tooltip component's controller; C93 (6)); text in a sentence is never cut. The card's link wraps its label in .sf-reference-link__label.

navigation.enabled: native anchor with a real href
navigation.boundary: the complete reference surface is the pointer and keyboard-focus boundary
navigation.gone: state missing or forbidden: no link, the reason in words

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-reference-link when a real destination benefits from a visible route, source or other compact reference.
do_not: Do not use Reference Link for a generic action or a plain text link
Do not render an enabled reference without href
Do not leave href on a disabled reference
Do not write the new-tab words or sign by hand: target _blank adds both
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

onClick.summary: Adds a click listener on the host.

aria-label.description: Accessible name of the link in place of its visible label, for a label that needs more words out of context. Empty: the label names it.
